profile_text.body:
Netflix is a publicly traded entertainment company headquartered in Los Gatos, California, listed under the ticker NFLX. Its investor site describes it as one of the world's leading entertainment services, offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. The company says members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. It reports over 260 million paid memberships in over 190 countries.

The company's own description of its business centers on streaming entertainment and games rather than on AI products, and no AI products are recorded for it. Its litigation record shows 270 cases in California.
